evidence_notes: Original probe retained: crash-budget case expects next worker EXHAUSTED, but reaper already persisted EXHAUSTED/failed so next claim correctly returns NOT_CLAIMABLE. Formal test asserts persistent terminal status, exact budget and no Agent rerun.
Initial probe outside repository had fixture-discovery errors; those are not counted as product RED and original-replay uses repository fixtures.
SQLite skips are only the two PostgreSQL-only row-lock/MVCC interleavings; PostgreSQL counterparts were executed and passed.
Live supervisor initially rejected transport SPAN sharing an id with the TOOL. Exact id+name+type read-only revalidation passed with no production source change or new Agent request.

Executor starvation additionally reproduced at b8bca1d and fixed in 3ce3fcf. All current local gates and a new real Langfuse/Agent/SIGKILL/restart were rerun at 3ce3fcf; older b8bca1d live evidence is not final acceptance.
